name: 空灵藤蔓

source: Allows you to unlock additional plant
right-clicking on a locked plant slot.
loreParagraphs.translation: 右键点击温室中已锁定的种植槽,即可解锁额外的种植槽.

source: This elusive vine seems to grow
loreParagraphs.translation: 这种难以捉摸的藤蔓似乎想长在哪就长在哪,无视自然规律.
